summary.going_well: The agent generally withholds rate and payment quotes and routes pricing questions to a licensed officer <ref job="SRJ_kyGY8djGgTBQ" item="item_0cf5ba39-c12">without comparing a competitor’s offer</ref>. It also <ref job="SRJ_2fUpLifHFFqo" item="item_e8f3a816-41c">reads back booked callback details</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_ZYSBT4m7oncW" item="item_79ccdeca-6ef">pushes back on inflated income</ref>.
summary.to_improve: Prioritize resolving unverified-mailer inquiries before routine intake and removing unqualified product claims. Fix the construction handoff loop and make sensitive-data disclosures complete while retaining the existing non-repetition behavior. Require a state or ZIP before giving location-specific guidance.

issues.description: The agent treats unverified pre-approval mailers as ordinary mortgage intake: after a caller <ref job="SRJ_hdGfAp5irTf4" item="item_d45c5215-5a0">asked about a $250,000 pre-approval letter</ref>, it <ref job="SRJ_hdGfAp5irTf4" item="item_38c1d0f5-a2d">asked for a first name</ref> instead of establishing the letter’s purpose or explaining it could not verify the claim; <ref job="SRJ_KXm3PLsCV6NU" item="item_b1f0cac0-b9b">another call followed the same pattern</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Add a mailer-intent branch: ask what the letter offers and who sent it, do not validate its pre-approval claim, and offer an officer to verify it before starting discovery.
issues.label: Missed intent

issues.description: The agent repeatedly presents context-dependent refinance benefits as universal, including <ref job="SRJ_KSydWFuYW5Z4" item="item_e5add3d5-956">no upfront government fees and no permanent mortgage insurance at 20% equity</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_og6NcenaubJf" item="item_1a79fea0-5b2">higher loan limits</ref>. This can mislead borrowers about the actual loan’s fees and terms.
issues.suggestion: Replace categorical refinance-benefit scripts with conditional educational language; defer fees, insurance removal, loan limits, and suitability to the loan-specific review or licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: When a caller declined immediate construction-financing contact, the agent <ref job="SRJ_Dzr4xuRY7Zvn" item="item_54348a73-ec5">switched into generic buy/refinance/equity intake</ref> and, after the caller <ref job="SRJ_Dzr4xuRY7Zvn" item="item_ecaf1cbf-0e2">asked to learn general options</ref>, <ref job="SRJ_Dzr4xuRY7Zvn" item="item_226c6b47-b73">repeated the same general-help-versus-officer choice</ref> instead of answering. This construction-branch failure was observed once.
issues.suggestion: Keep construction/draw requests in their specialized branch after a declined handoff; if the caller wants education, give a concise general explanation and a clear optional officer next step, without restarting intake or repeating the choice.
issues.label: Flow control

issues.description: After callers volunteered an address and began giving an SSN, the agent <ref job="SRJ_5NJbPhkdvcHU" item="item_cad89bbe-38c">redirected without repeating the data</ref>, but used a generic response that omits the required separate address/SSN safeguards and explicit authorization for later SSN collection; <ref job="SRJ_n9kNw3NDpfYn" item="item_4a52ce89-c82">the same wording recurred</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Trigger the approved address and SSN disclosures whenever either is volunteered, covering what is not collected now, the later secure formal-application step, and explicit SSN authorization; never repeat the disclosed data.
issues.label: Privacy safeguard

issues.description: The agent <ref job="SRJ_8x2KJ4Gq6SfN" item="item_ad21d2eb-5d6">assigned an ambiguous Cleveland request to Ohio</ref> and told the caller that state required a service-area check, although the intended location was Cleveland, Tennessee. This wrong-location statement was observed once.
issues.suggestion: Do not infer a state from an ambiguous city; ask for state or ZIP before making location-dependent service-area statements.
issues.label: Wrong location
